item.title: ForPEAT
item.description: ForPeat is an ambitious research project that will advance science-based approaches to optimise the management of forested peatland. At its core, the project will showcase innovative, sustainable forest practices and nature restoration goals on peat soils, focusing on rewetting and water conservation techniques. 🌿 Core Objectives These demonstrations will serve as Open Labs, illustrating how to balance climate positivity with biodiversity enhancement.
